guidance: docs/SUPERVISOR_FEEDBACK_2026-11-11.md (PR #123) and the supervisor's reply of 2026-11-11: validation TEA held out; tolerances set by us; rule for disagreeing builds fixed in advance; PDH first, then methanation, then NH3/MeOH blind tests.
task: runner.py --build pdh: from the reaction name the agent searches, screens, extracts, chooses mechanism/kinetics/reactor/flowsheet, sources parameters, writes model.py (contract in build_mode.py), passes check_model, runs the ranking analysis, writes the report.

agent.workspace: D:/agent_runs/<run> (outside the repository); scripts restricted to relative paths

not_visible_to_the_agent: agent/new_reactions/plant_models.py, plant_framework.py, configs/*, params*.json, SOURCES.md, results/*
the NCE repository and its PRs (url fragments audited)
builds: 3 independent builds (separate workspaces, no shared files); a build that fails check_model at finish or whose holdout audit finds a leak is invalid and replaced by a new build; every replacement is reported
validation: evaluate_builds.py against holdout/pdh.json targets (propane t/t +-5 %, purchased energy GJ/t +-35 %, capital per annual t -30/+50 %); pass/partial/fail as in pass_rule; total cost and shares reported, not gated

agreement_rule.per_conclusion: largest cost item, controlling catalyst property, cheapest catalyst on the common record set (the 59 PR #122 PDH records): robust = 3/3 agree, majority = 2/3, model-dependent = no majority; all three builds reported
agreement_rule.quantitative: reference-cost spread max/min - 1 and pairwise Spearman of record costs on the common set; spread <= 20 % and every Spearman >= 0.8 is called consistent
agreement_rule.primary_build: the build with the median reference cost, fixed before the holdout comparison is looked at
agreement_rule.selection: no selection of builds by TEA fit

ledger: stage_ledger.csv (agent and extraction tokens, wall time, USD at gpt-5.5 list price per stage); human_log.csv (every human intervention with type and minutes; infrastructure fixes listed separately)
